purpose: 54 selected additional drawings interleaved with v2 for108 total frames

specs.name: 힘찬 독려
specs.end: Her empty left hand becomes an encouraging fist beside her shoulder, smiling brightly with an open mouth. Keep the right hand holding her original sword lowered diagonally, as in reference1.

specs.name: 밝은 인사
specs.end: Her empty left hand rises gradually from her hip into a friendly open-palm greeting beside her shoulder, eyes brighten and then one eye winks softly. Right hand keeps original sword lowered.

specs.name: 머쓱한 웃음
specs.end: Her empty left hand slowly lifts from hip to behind her head for a sheepish little scratch, smile becomes bashfully closed-eye with a slight blush. Right hand keeps original sword lowered.

specs.name: 다정한 환영
specs.end: Her free left hand leaves the sword hilt and slowly opens toward the viewer at waist height in a warm welcoming gesture, her eyes gradually smile closed. Her round lotus shield on right arm remains at her side.

specs.name: 단단한 수호
specs.end: She gently but firmly raises her original right-arm lotus shield from side to front of torso, with increasingly determined yet kind eyes. Free left hand remains by the sheathed sword. No attack or jump.

specs.name: 동료 안심시키기
specs.end: Her free left hand leaves the sword hilt, comes briefly near her heart, and opens slightly forward toward a worried friend at chest level; expression softly reassuring, head only a very slight tilt. Right-arm shield stays at side.

specs.name: 도도한 팔짱
specs.end: She gradually withdraws her originally extended left hand and releases sword pommel with right hand to cross both arms tightly over her chest. Chin lifts only slightly, a small proud knowing smirk, composed not angry. The sword stays sheathed and fixed at her hip.

specs.name: 짧은 지휘
specs.end: Her originally extended left hand slowly retracts toward chest then gives a concise palm-down command forward; right hand rests on her sword pommel, eyes serious and focused. Restraint, no theatrical flailing.

specs.name: 숨기는 고마움
specs.end: She gradually draws her left hand toward cape fastening at collar with fingertips briefly adjusting it, then lowers that hand slightly to her chest, looking a little aside with a tiny appreciative blush and a restrained proud smile. Right hand stays by sword pommel.

repairs.end: Her free left hand leaves the sword hilt and slowly opens toward the viewer at waist height in a warm welcoming gesture, her eyes gradually smile closed. Her round lotus shield on right arm remains at her side.
